name: Band Tibialis Raise
cues: Sit with your legs out straight and loop the band over the tops of your feet
Anchor the band low in front of you so it pulls your toes away
Pull your toes back toward your shins as far as you can
Let the band draw your feet forward slowly before the next rep

qa.note: Wave 3b 2026-10-09: rated minor, owner review. minor: The band behaves correctly: the ball-to-anchor distance grows by about 7 cm on dorsiflexion from -32 to +10, the anchor sits low in front and the knees stay within 8 mm. But the anchor is a 32 kg dumbbell while equipment lists only the band, which suggests a dumbbell is needed. The arms prop at 55 deg of shoulder extension, and the seated figure fills a small part of the tile. There is no foot contact gate, so floor and mat clearance are the only checks.
